characters.layout: 4 columns × 2 rows; Faísca top facing right, Pipo bottom facing left
characters.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: transparent PNG sprite animation sheet for a friendly educational tug-of-war game.
Input image 1: Faísca, the authoritative blue lightbulb mascot with yellow lightning tuft, screw base, white gloves and blue sneakers.
Input image 2: Pipo, authoritative orange rocket mascot with blue nose cone and fins, white gloves and blue sneakers.
Preserve these exact mascot identities and polished 3D cartoon style. Create exactly 8 full-body sprites in a STRICT REGULAR 4-COLUMN by 2-ROW grid. Each cell equal size, same character scale and grounded feet baseline, consistent studio lighting, transparent gutters. Row 1 ONLY Faísca facing RIGHT, row 2 ONLY Pipo facing LEFT. Side-three-quarter views, eyes friendly and focused toward opponent.
Four successive poses for each row make one seamless pulling loop: column1 braced stance with both hands gripping toward opponent; column2 bends knees and leans back slightly; column3 stronger backward pull with elbows closer to waist; column4 begins relaxing back toward column1. Hands held forward at waist level, gripping an imaginary horizontal rope. Do not render rope: a separate animated rope is layered by the game. Bodies stay within the same central cell bounding box; changes between frames small enough for fluid looping, around 10% pose displacement. Weight on feet, comical effort, determined smile, never angry. Each character fully visible, no crop, no overlapping frames, no captions.
Output ONE landscape transparent PNG, strict 4x2 grid, no panels, no background or ground, no environmental effects, no shadows outside character silhouette, no motion trails, no other people, no text, no watermarks. Actual alpha transparency outside all 8 sprites. Match school-game blue/orange/yellow palette and expressive clean 3D modeled cartoon forms.

rope.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: one reusable horizontal rope texture strip for a friendly 3D cartoon tug-of-war game.
Create ONE long straight taut braided golden rope running horizontally through the exact vertical center of a wide landscape transparent PNG. Consistent thickness along the length, rounded intertwined strands clearly visible, school-game chunky 3D modeled toy aesthetic, navy contour, orange shaded grooves, soft golden highlights. Rope runs almost edge to edge, with two small simple knots near its ends, equal height and no sag. Rope occupies about 12% of total image height, surrounded by large transparent padding above and below. Wide image ratio 3:1.
No characters, no hands, no labels, no flag, no background or scene, no watermark, no text, no floor, no cast shadow, no glow. Actual alpha transparency everywhere outside the rope silhouette. This strip will be layered behind the white gloves of Faísca and Pipo and moved horizontally when a player answers correctly.
